summary: @onereach/si-checkbox-group preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue checkbox UI component but ships a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file (`math_init.js`) on the installer's host at install time. Both the launcher (`setup.mjs`) and the payload are heavily obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses obfuscator.io-style `_0x`-prefixed identifier mangling with per-scope constant-proxy objects; `math_init.js` uses a rotating string-array cipher (`WV8StW` push/shift over a ~500-element mixed literal/hex array). Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime (Bun) rather than Node evades Node-based tooling and sandboxing. A UI checkbox library has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime, a bootstrap named `math_init`, or install-time obfuscated code execution — the combination is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack shape, granting the publisher arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
